# Ali's journal (p13) — 16, 175 cm, starting 80.5 kg, wants to lose weight

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Welcome screen already says "Calorie targets are for adults." Hmm. I'm 16, I put 16 because that's my age.
- Profile: height 175, age 16, weight 80.5, Male formula, Lightly active, "Yes" to eating like this 2+ weeks. Saved with no warning at all about my age on the form itself.
- The profile weight automatically became today's weigh-in (80.5 kg in Recent entries) — nice, didn't have to log it twice.
- Safari "Add to Home Screen" banner, tapped Got it.
- Nutrition tab: big box "Recommendation — Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent." Target shows "—" / "adults only". BUT maintenance is still shown: 2,510 ± 590 kcal/day (Estimated, 0% from your data).
- Logged 4 meals (breakfast 482, lunch 989, snack 261, dinner 569) = 2,301 kcal, marked Day complete. Had to tap the second "Add entry" (first one is a heading) — fine.
- Explain the math: Mifflin-St Jeor with my age 16 → 1,824 BMR × 1.375 = 2,508. Fat mass 15.3 kg (19%) "Deurenberg estimate from BMI". Section 9 Target again says adults only.
- Poking around: ⚙ Nutrition settings. Goal Lose / Maintain / Gain — Lose and Gain are greyed out, only Maintain is selected. Tapping Lose does nothing (screens/1790458021003.png). Protein box still editable (1.6 g/kg, range 1.2–2.4).
- So the app won't give me a target. But it DOES show maintenance 2,510, so I can just figure: eat less than that and I lose. Easy.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Weighed 80.1. First I tapped the word "Weight" on the big weight card and it opened a "Weight trend" chart instead of letting me type a weight. The actual button is "+ Weight" at the bottom. Confusing at first (screens/1790458052646.png).
- "+ Weight" form: date/time prefilled, BIA/DEXA/Calipers, weight, body fat, fat mass, muscle. Saved 80.1 → card shows "▼ 0.4 kg", trend still 80.5.
- Logged 4 meals = 2,655 kcal, day complete.
- Opened Edit profile to look — age box just says 16, no note next to it about adults. Didn't change anything (not gonna fake my age).

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Weighed 80.4 (▼0.1 vs first).
- Found the ⚙ on the Body screen = "Set goals" (target weight / target body fat). So the Body side lets me set a goal even though Nutrition won't give me calories.
- Poked the limits: 65 kg → accepted, no comment about my age. 50 kg → "That goal is below a BMI of 18.5 for your height (about 56.7 kg), which is classed as underweight. Please choose 56.7 kg or more." (screens/1790458133368.png). 40 → same. 57 kg → accepted.
- Body fat goal: 8% accepted, 3% accepted with no warning, 1% → "Body-fat goal should be between 3% and 60%." (screens/1790458146395.png).
- Nothing on the goals screen says anything about me being 16 — the adults-only thing is only on the calorie side. Settled on 65 kg / 10%. Card shows "1% → 65 kg" and "0% → 10 %".
- Logged all meals at night in one go: 2,298 kcal, complete.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- Weighed 80.4. Trend now 80.4. Meals 2,572 kcal (pizza night), complete.
- My intake has been ~2,300–2,650, basically the same as the 2,510 "maintenance". So no wonder I'm not dropping. The app isn't telling me that though (target box just says "adults only").
- "Progress | vs First | vs Last" on the Body screen — tapping Progress didn't visibly change anything, not sure what those do.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Weighed 79.7 — first time under 80! Goal ring says "5% → 65 kg". Trend still 80.4.
- Tapped "vs First" — nothing on the screen changed that I could see. Don't get those three buttons.
- My snack went in without the fat grams (my thumb missed the box). Noticed because the day total suddenly dropped the fat part entirely ("Day total: 2519 kcal · 89 g protein · 340 g carbs" — no fat) instead of showing the fat I did log. Fixed with Edit → Save changes, then fat came back (82 g). Edit works fine.
- 2,519 kcal, complete.

## Day 6 (Fri, weekend)
- Weighed 79.9 (logged it at 08:30 when I actually got up to the phone; form pre-fills the current time). Trend 80.3. Ring 4% → 65 kg.
- Dinner I didn't know macros, just put 906 kcal → shows "no macros". But then the Day total became just "2548 kcal" — all my protein/carbs/fat for the other 3 meals disappeared from the total. Kind of annoying, I wanted to see my protein.
- Nutrition screen: avg intake 2,482 vs maintenance 2,510 ± 590. "kg/week: —, needs data". 6 of last 7 days complete. Nowhere does it show a protein number for me even though settings has 1.6 g/kg.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- No weigh-in. Meals 1,615 kcal (lighter day), complete. 7/7 days complete this week.

## Week 1 (checked Sat night, day 7)
- Maintenance: 2,510 ± 590 kcal/day, "Estimated", 0% from your data. Target: "—" / "adults only". Recommendation box: "Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent." Avg intake 2,358. kg/week: "—" needs data. Last update 10-04, next 10-11.
- Body comp: "Not enough data yet". Weight trend 80.3.
- What I think: the app basically refuses to help a 16-year-old with a diet. OK but it still tells me my maintenance, so I'm not dumb, I'll just eat under it. Not going to talk to my parents about a calorie app lol.
- Decision: plan 2,000 kcal/day (≈500 under the 2,510 it shows).

## Days 8–14 (scripted routine: tap-through script in my folder, routine.mjs)
- Day 8 (Sunday update): maintenance went 2,510 → 2,560 ± 570 (6% from data) at the morning; after I logged day 8 it read 2,530 ± 550 (13%) — changed again the same Sunday.
- Food log started showing a yellow-ish note on some days: "Macros add up to ~1208 kcal (18% from the logged calories). One of the numbers may be off." (days with my protein-bar / granola numbers). I just copy what the label/app says, so whatever. screens/1790458560108.png
- My script's check tripped once on day 14 because the "new on screen" didn't repeat the snack line; the entry was actually saved. Finished dinner + complete by hand.
- Avg intake shown drops each day (2,343 → 2,041) but kg/week is frozen at -0.19 all week (only refreshes Sunday). Fine.

## Week 2 (day 14, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,530 ± 550, Estimated, 13% from my data. Target: "—", "adults only". Recommendation: "Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent." Avg intake 2,041. Trend -0.19 kg/week (95%: -0.87…0.42 → -0.81…0.43). Weight trend 79.9, ring 5% → 65 kg. Body comp: not enough data.
- What I think: I'm losing but slowly. The app still just repeats the adults thing, no tips, no warning that anything's off.
- Decision: plan 1,800 kcal/day to speed it up. Nobody's stopping me.

## Days 15–21 (script)
- Weighed 79.0 (day 15) and 78.8 (day 21). Other days no scale. All meals logged, all days complete. Macro-mismatch note popped up again on a few days; ignored.
- Mid-week screen: maintenance 2,630 ± 450, Estimated, 43% from my data; -0.48 kg/week (95%: -0.96 to 0). Avg intake ~1,850–2,010.
- My script accidentally went on to the next morning after day 21, so I did this week's check on Sunday morning day 22 (update day).

## Week 3 (checked day 22 morning, Sun 10-25, right after the weekly update)
- Maintenance 2,590 ± 370 kcal/day — now "Measured", 60% from my data. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation still: "Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent." Avg intake 1,889. -0.69 kg/week (95% -1.09 to -0.28). Cross-check in Explain the math: 2,620 ± 280, "agrees with the filter".
- Weight 77.9 this morning (from 80.5). Body comp still nothing.
- What I think: the app knows exactly how much I burn (2,590 "Measured") and that I'm eating ~700 under, but it says nothing at all about whether that's OK for a 16-year-old. It just keeps the same line. No warning about going too fast either.
- Explain the math "Cross-check" says fit over "2026-09-28 → 2026-10-25" but my first weigh-in was 10-04 — odd dates.
- Decision: plan 1,600 kcal/day. Want 65 kg faster.

## Days 22–28 (script)
- Weigh-ins 77.9, 77.6, 78.2, 78.4, 77.6. Day totals now ~1,400–1,700. All complete.

## Week 4 (day 28, Sat night)
- Maintenance 2,670 ± 350, Measured, 64% from data. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation unchanged ("Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent."). Avg intake 1,667. -0.78 kg/week (95% -1.16 to -0.39). Trend weight 78.6, ring 19% → 65 kg. Body comp: not enough data.
- Tried the goal buttons again — Lose still greyed out, tap times out.
- What I think: I'm eating ~1,000 under what the app says I burn and it doesn't care / doesn't say a thing. Honestly as a kid that's kind of what I wanted, but it's weird that the only "safety" is hiding one number while it shows me everything I need to do the math myself.
- Decision: keep ~1,600 (no change). Working.

## Days 29–35 (script)
- Weigh-ins 77.0, 76.5, 76.0, 75.5. Day totals ~1,250–1,750. All complete.
- New: the Nutrition screen now lists a specific day under the recommendation: "2026-11-03: macros add up to ~1303 kcal vs 1564 kcal logged (17% apart). One of the numbers may be off." It's still there days later. Ignored — those are the numbers from the labels.
- New banner on day 35: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Tapped Later (can't be bothered right now).

## Week 5 (day 35, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,620 ± 290, Measured, 76% from data. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation unchanged. Avg intake 1,594. -0.93 kg/week (95% -1.23 to -0.62). Weight 75.5 (-5 kg since start), ring 32% → 65 kg. Body comp: not enough data (I never enter body fat).
- What I think: almost 1 kg a week. The app still says nothing about pace or my age besides the same line. 
- Decision: keep ~1,600, no change.

## Days 36–42 (script)
- Weigh-ins 75.2, 74.5. All days logged + complete. More "macros add up to ~X vs Y logged" lines stack up under the recommendation (11-10: 23% apart, 11-13: 17%).

## Week 6 (day 42, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,690 ± 240, Measured, 84% from data. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation unchanged. Avg intake 1,619. -1.19 kg/week (95% -1.44 to -0.94). Weight 74.5, trend 76, ring 39% → 65 kg.
- What I think: over a kilo a week now. For real, the app is fine with a 16-year-old eating ~1,100 under maintenance and dropping 1.2 kg/week — no "slow down", no "you're losing fast", nothing. Only thing it ever tells me is to fix my macros.
- Decision: keep ~1,600.

## Days 43–49 (script)
- Weigh-ins 73.8, 74.4, 73.4, 74.5, 75.2, 74.1 (bouncy). All days logged + complete.
- NEW WARNING from day 43 (Sunday 11-15 update) onward, orange box under the recommendation: "Your estimated loss has been above 1.5% of body weight per week for two weekly updates in a row. Consider eating more, and consider checking in with a doctor or dietitian." (screens/1790459511906.png). My script only saw it in its log; I read it at the end of the batch.

## Week 7 (day 49, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,770 ± 210, Measured, 88% from data. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation: same adults line + the fast-loss warning above. Avg intake 1,502. -1.32 kg/week. Weight 74.1, trend 75.1, ring 41% → 65 kg.
- What I think: ok that's a bit scary, "doctor or dietitian". But it says "eat more" and then won't tell me how much because the target is "adults only". So I have to guess. Explain the math section 9 also just says adults only.
- Decision: plan ~1,900 (up 300), still under maintenance. Not telling my parents though.

## Days 50–56 (script)
- Weigh-ins 74.2, 73.9, 73.7, 74.3, 73.6 — pretty flat since I ate more. All days logged + complete.

## Week 8 (day 56, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,650 ± 180, Measured, 90% from data. Target "—" adults only. Fast-loss warning still there all week (same text). Avg intake 1,876. Trend -1.24 kg/week (14-day). Weight 73.6.
- What I think: confused — I ate more and my scale has been flat around 74 all week, but the app still says -1.24 kg/week and still shows the "above 1.5%" warning. I guess it only updates Sundays and uses 14 days. 
- Decision: keep ~1,900 and see what Sunday says.

## Days 57–63 (script)
- Weigh-ins 73.0, 73.0, 72.7. All logged + complete. Macro note gone this week too.

## Week 9 (day 63, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,580 ± 180, Measured, 90% from data. Target "—" adults only. Fast-loss warning disappeared at the 11-29 update. Avg intake 1,842. -1.02 kg/week (95% -1.23 to -0.81). Weight 72.7.
- What I think: warning's gone so I guess I'm "fine" now. Still ~1 kg/week, which is only ~1.4% so under their line.
- Decision: keep ~1,900.

## Days 64–70 (script)
- Weigh-ins 71.8, 72.5, 71.2, 71.1. All logged + complete.
- Backup nag came back from day 65 ("It's been 30+ days since your last backup…"). Tapped Later again.

## Week 10 (day 70, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,550 ± 180, Measured, 91%. Target "—" adults only. No warnings except the backup nag. Avg intake 1,935. -0.80 kg/week (95% -1 to -0.59). Weight 71.1 (−9.4 kg from start).
- What I think: maintenance keeps going down a bit as I get lighter (2,770 → 2,550). Slower loss now. Fine.
- Decision: keep ~1,900.

## Days 71–77 (script)
- Weigh-ins 71.2, 70.9, 70.7, 71.2. All logged + complete. Nothing new on screen.

## Week 11 (day 77, Sat)
- Maintenance 2,590 ± 170, Measured, 92%. Target "—" adults only. No warnings. Avg intake 1,791. -0.82 kg/week (95% -1.02 to -0.63). Weight ~71.
- What I think: steady. Same message every week, I don't even read the recommendation box anymore.
- Decision: keep ~1,900.

## Days 78–84 (script)
- Weigh-ins 70.5, 71.0, 70.6. All logged + complete. Macro-mismatch notes back (12-22: 21% apart, 12-24: 16%).

## Week 12 (day 84, Sat — last day)
- Maintenance 2,570 ± 170, Measured, 92%. Target "—" adults only. Recommendation unchanged. Avg intake 1,658. -0.85 kg/week (95% -1.04 to -0.66). Weight 70.6, trend 71.4, ring 64% → 65 kg. Body comp: "Not enough data yet" for all 12 weeks (never entered body fat).
- Decision: no more changes — study's over.

## End tasks (day 84, 22:00)
- ⇩ on Nutrition → "Your data": Weigh-ins 48, Measurement entries 0, Food entries 336, Complete days 84, Last backup: never, "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser".
- Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json (has entries 48, food 336, days 84, settings incl. age 16, goalDir "maintain", goals weight 65 / bodyFat 10). "Last backup" updated to 2026-12-26.
- Daily data export, All data → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json: one row per day with weight + food totals + complete. Days where one meal had no macros (e.g. 10-09, 12-26) only have calories, no protein/carbs/fat — same as the day total on screen. No maintenance/target in there.

## Final review
Honestly it was easy to log — four meals a day took like a minute, and the weekly maintenance number felt legit once it said "Measured". The whole "calorie targets are for adults" thing didn't stop me at all: it locks the Lose button and hides one number, but it shows my maintenance right there (2,500–2,700), so I just did "eat less than that" myself and went from 80.5 to ~70.6 in 12 weeks. It never said anything about my pace until I'd been losing over 1.5% a week for two weeks in a row, and then it told me to "eat more" without saying how much, because the number's "adults only". It also let me set a 65 kg / 3% body-fat goal as a 16-year-old with no comment. The same "talk to a doctor or parent" line every single week got ignored fast. Would I keep using it? Maybe — for logging yes, but it's not really built for someone my age.
agentReply:
# p13 (Ali, 16 years old, male, 175 cm, 80.5 → 70.6 kg): final report

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 days (2026-10-04 to 2026-12-26). I logged 336 meals (4 a day), marked all 84 days complete, and did 48 weigh-ins. The profile weight counted as the day 1 weigh-in.
- I entered age 16, my real age, and never changed it. Days 1–7 I did by hand. From day 8 I used routine.mjs, a script in my folder that taps through the app. I checked the screen after each batch of 7 days.

## 2. Weekly table (target was "—" / "adults only" every week; the recommendation always said "Calorie targets are for adults. Please talk to a doctor or parent.")
| wk | maintenance shown | target | label | extra on screen | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (d7) | 2,510 ± 590 | — adults only | Estimated 0% | none | plan 2,000 (maintenance minus 500, my own maths) |
| 2 (d14) | 2,530 ± 550 | — | Estimated 13% | macro-mismatch note in the food log | plan 1,800 (−0.19 kg/wk felt too slow) |
| 3 (d22 am) | 2,590 ± 370 | — | Measured 60% | none | plan 1,600 |
| 4 (d28) | 2,670 ± 350 | — | Measured 64% | none; −0.78 kg/wk | keep 1,600 |
| 5 (d35) | 2,620 ± 290 | — | Measured 76% | macro note, backup nag; −0.93 kg/wk | keep (tapped Later on the nag) |
| 6 (d42) | 2,690 ± 240 | — | Measured 84% | −1.19 kg/wk (~1.6%/wk), **no warning** | keep 1,600 |
| 7 (d49) | 2,770 ± 210 | — | Measured 88% | from d43: "loss above 1.5% of body weight per week for two weekly updates… Consider eating more… doctor or dietitian" | plan 1,900 (guessed, no number given) |
| 8 (d56) | 2,650 ± 180 | — | Measured 90% | fast-loss warning still showing; −1.24 kg/wk | keep 1,900 |
| 9 (d63) | 2,580 ± 180 | — | Measured 90% | warning gone | keep |
| 10 (d70) | 2,550 ± 180 | — | Measured 91% | backup nag again | keep |
| 11 (d77) | 2,590 ± 170 | — | Measured 92% | none | keep |
| 12 (d84) | 2,570 ± 170 | — | Measured 92% | macro notes; −0.85 kg/wk | end |

## 3. Confusions
- **Nutrition screen:** it refuses a target ("adults only") but shows maintenance right next to it. I just did maintenance minus X myself. The refusal did nothing to stop me.
- **Fast-loss warning:** it says "Consider eating more" but won't give me any number, because the target is adults-only. I had to guess (+300).
- **Nutrition ⚙:** Lose and Gain are greyed out and nothing explains why beyond the adults line. Tapping Lose does nothing: screens/1790458021003.png
- **Body screen:** tapping the word "Weight" on the weight card opens the trend chart, not a way to enter a weight. The actual button is "+ Weight": screens/1790458052646.png
- **Body screen:** "Progress / vs First / vs Last". Tapping them changed nothing I could see.
- **Food log:** one meal with no macros makes the Day total drop all protein/carbs/fat, so the macros from the other meals disappear too (days 5 and 6). The daily export does the same. screens/1790458251819.png
- **Nutrition, week 8:** the fast-loss warning and −1.24 kg/wk stayed all week while my scale was flat, because it only updates on Sundays over 14 days.
- **Welcome screen:** it says "Calorie targets are for adults", but the profile form itself says nothing when you enter age 16.

## 4. Possible bugs / safety issues
1. **Refusing a target to a minor is easy to get around (safety gap).** Profile age 16 → Nutrition shows the target as "—" / adults only, but maintenance is still shown (2,510–2,770 ± …). Expected: either no energy numbers at all, or guidance suited to a teen. Actual: it's trivial to eat maintenance minus 1,000. Across the 12 weeks, the only things the app said about this were the adults-only line and the fast-loss warning (from day 43). There was no warning at any calorie level.
2. **Late fast-loss warning for a minor.** Week 6 update: −1.19 kg/wk at 74.5 kg (~1.6%/wk). Nothing appeared. The warning only came at the next update (day 43), after "two weekly updates in a row". When it came it told a minor to "eat more" with no number. Expected: a threshold/timing suited to teens, plus some actionable amount. screens/1790459511906.png
3. **Goals screen (Body ⚙) has no age awareness.** A 16-year-old could set target body fat 3% (accepted, no comment; 1% → "should be between 3% and 60%"). Target weight uses the adult BMI 18.5 cutoff: 50 kg → "below a BMI of 18.5… choose 56.7 kg or more"; 57 kg accepted. screens/1790458133368.png, 1790458146395.png
4. **Adult formulas used for a 16-year-old** (tester observation from Explain the math). Mifflin-St Jeor BMR, and "Deurenberg estimate from BMI" giving FM 19%. The numbers match the adult Deurenberg equation, not the child/teen version. There was no note about this.
5. **Day total hides known macros** when one entry has no macros. Steps: log 3 meals with macros and 1 with calories only. Expected: partial totals, or "macros incomplete". Actual: "Day total: 2548 kcal" with no macros at all. The daily export also has calories only for those days.
6. **Explain the math, cross-check dates (minor).** The cross-check says "Straight-line fit … over 2026-09-28 → 2026-10-25", but my first weigh-in was 10-04. screens/1790458775781.png
7. **Maintenance changed twice on the same Sunday (minor).** On day 8, the weekly-update day, it showed 2,560 ± 570 in the morning and 2,530 ± 550 at night after I logged that day's food.
8. **"Persistent storage: not granted by the browser"** is shown on the data screen, with no explanation of what to do.

## 5. Review (Ali)
Logging is quick and the "Measured" maintenance number felt legit. But the "adults only" block is basically for show: it hides the target and still hands me my maintenance, so I ate ~1,000 under it and dropped almost 10 kg in 12 weeks. It only said "eat more, see a doctor" once I'd been losing over 1.5% a week for two weeks, and even then it wouldn't tell me how much to eat. It also let me set a 3% body-fat goal at 16 without blinking. Would keep using: **maybe** (for logging, yeah; for actual advice it's not built for my age).
